Name: Cherry Fields(Custom Farm)
Author: kittnet
Description:
[center][b][size=5]🌸 [u]An open field surrounded by blooming pink cherry trees[/u] 🌸

[/size][/b][size=3]This was meant to be somewhat of a parallel to the standard farm. I think it's pretty, so I hope you like it too~.

Though the field is open and lush, there is a lot of grass; farming may be difficult, but the openness will surely make up for it.

[/size][size=5]🌸 🌸 🌸[/size][size=3] [size=5]🌸[/size][size=3]  [/size][size=5]🌸[/size][size=3] [/size][/size][/center][b][size=4][u]Requirements:[/u]

[/size][size=3]🌸 [/size][/b][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/b]

[b][size=3]🌸[/size][/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][size=2] (unless you would like to edit the config file yourself)[/size][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3]

[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][b][size=3]🌸[/size][/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27117]Sharogg's Tilesheets
[/url]

[b][size=4][u]Features:[/u]

[/size][size=3]🌸 [/size][/b][size=3]does not replace vanilla farms; choosable from the additional farms menu

[b][size=3]🌸 [/size][/b][size=3]i18n support(however, I used machine translations, so I apologise if they're awkward...)

[size=3][b][size=3]🌸 (optional) [/size][/b][size=3]seasonal farm cave with a pool(only when using the Cherry Fields farm map)

[size=3][b][size=3]🌸 (optional) [/size][/b][size=3]two new types of fish(two colours of ricefish, and cherry ricefish) that only spawn on the farm[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3](only when using the Cherry Fields farm map)[/size][/size][/size][/size]

[size=3][b][size=3]🌸 [/size][/b][size=3]two different starting gifts; pick before starting a new save on this farm[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]


[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][size=4][b][u]Config:
[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][b][size=3]🌸[/size][/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][size=3] [b]RECOLOUR:[/b] if you're using a recolour, select whichever one you're using(or suits your recolour the best); this will change the colour of the petal tiles to match

[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][b][size=3]🌸[/size][/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size] [b]STARTING GIFT: [/b]choose between 15 parsnips or 10 strawberries
[/size]
[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][b][size=3]🌸[/size][/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size] [size=3][b]WORLDMAP: [/b]whether or not to use Cherry Fields custom world map; it will clash with mods that recolour the world map, so turn it off if it bothers you, and it will instead use the Standard farm's map[/size]

[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][b][size=3]🌸[/size][/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size] [size=3][b]ADD RICEFISH: [/b]whether or not you want the new ricefish; if you turn it off, the farm will instead have vanilla fish(sunfish, carp, chub, shad, perch)
[/size]
[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][b][size=3]🌸[/size][/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size] [size=3][b]ENABLE CAVE: [/b]whether or not you'd like to use the custom farm cave; if enabled, it will only appear on saves using the Cherry Fields farm map

[/size][u]
[/u][size=4][b][u]Recommended:[/u]
[/b][/size]
[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][b][size=3]🌸[/size][/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size] [size=3]any mods that allow you to plant crops on grass if the limitations bother you, such as [url=https://github.com/Sparky56p/AnythingAnywhere/releases]Anything Anywhere[/url] (unofficial update, original upload [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]here[/url])
